title: Electrified Tree
body:
The Electrified Tree is an uncommon rarity tree in Oaklands. This tree can spawn anywhere on the surface during a thunderstorm. It does not replace normal trees naturally. However, Michael’s Copper Axe can be used to attract lightning near a tree (during a thunderstorm) to create an electrified tree. It is one of three tree types that can spawn from an Electrified Meteor.

Description

According to the developer, Electrified Trees and their counterparts have no specific equation to follow when spawning - it is a percent chance for one to spawn on the surface during a Thunderstorm.

Electrified Trees can spawn along side Eel Kelp or Electrified Bamboo at an Electrified Meteor crash site.

Electrified Trees have roughly the same toughness as a Birch tree.

Trivia

  • Patch v1.34.1 changed the color from greenish-blue to light blue.
  • Electrified Tree has an alternative unused teal blue wood texture instead of the neon texture.
  • When sanded or planked, Electrified Tree is the fourth-most valuable tree in the game, only coming short of Plek, Magma Trees, and Mysterious Mushrooms.
